Any of these ‘families’ of induction can be done as light inductions, with eyes open, or instead of trance you can just do them as a contact. Once you start an induction, you will want to notice what’s going on (even if nothing changes) and work out what to do next, move, imagine something else, change the sensory channel you’re using, do nothing, stop the induction sequence and do something else… . Whatever you do, make sure you bring yourself fully back to waking at the end of an induction.

changes.text: Care workshop: prepare the workshop (time, place, tools, boundaries, etc). Invite the signal/feeling/young part to come only as close as is welcome. Try to avoid any language that makes you not one person. Care for it as best you can, by asking what it wants and giving that if you can, or sensing into it and responding, or just being with it. Take breaks, get back in contact if that's ok, take more breaks, etc. Keep bringing in adult functions (or borrow someone else's function). Have the adult part of you run the show. Goal is to make it "good as you", not to erase history. Close the workspace, reassure yourself that you are one whole person, that you're an adult now, and come back.
